<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2101-2026-09-1501-30-39" status="reviewed">
de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3827">slob dpon kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs></note> na re sems can gyi khams thog ma nyid nas sku gnyis kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa la | 'u skol blo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas mi gsal bas tshogs gnyis kyis gsal bar <lb edRef="inst:4622" n="59b2"/> byed pa ni <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3749">rgyud bla ma</rs>'i dgongs pa yin te | nor bu rin po che dri mas gos nas ngo ma shes pa shes par byed ba'i thabs su dang po lan tsha'i chu dang | skri'i re ba rtsub mos dag par byed pa dang | bar du zas kyi khur ba rnon po dang bal gyis dag par byed pa dang | th mar sman chen po'i khu bas ras srab mos dag par byed pa bzhin du | sems can gyi khams la de bzhin gshegs  <lb edRef="inst:4622" n="59b3"/> pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med par yod pa blo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i dri ma sel ba'i thabs su tshogs gnyis gsungs pa bzhin no zhes gsungs so ||</seg></TEI>
